n.exclusions: From 70 recruited: 5 early simultaneous bilinguals or unclear native-speaker status; 1 speech/hearing pathology; 3 below two SDs on perception control; 1 extreme retrieval-induced inhibition value; 2 missing production data. Final 58.

reported_success.quote: Despite the lack of finding similar effects for the correlation analyses, a comparison of the descriptive statistics indicated comparability between the two studies

notes: Original locator p. 23 corresponds to published Table 7; the retrieved accepted manuscript has different pagination (Table 7 on p. 32). Replication uses Spearman rather than Pearson because Pearson assumptions were violated (p. 1401). No conversion performed. Original p is a printed one-tailed significance bound from Table 7, not the hierarchical regression p. Reported success records the author’s narrative failure to find similar correlation effects; the quotation concerns the correlation analyses collectively.
